title: Regulatory Amendment Mechanism for Customs Notifications
summary: The evolution of the amendment process reflects a shift from the Customs Act 1969 to the Customs Act 2023 as the primary legal basis for modifying existing SROs. The mechanism consistently involves the government, in consultation with the NBR, issuing SROs to update HS codes, conditions, or specific entries in previous notifications to align with changing fiscal or trade policies.

evolution.legal_basis: Shifted from Customs Act 1969 to Customs Act 2023.
evolution.scope: Expanded from simple HS code replacement to include insertion of new conditions and regulatory clauses.

timeline.change: Initial use of Customs Act 1969 and VAT Act 1991 to amend HS codes in existing SROs.
Expansion of amendment scope to include insertion of new conditions and specific HS code adjustments.
Transition to Customs Act 2023 as the legal basis for amendments, replacing the 1969 Act.
